name: portfolio-nathan-quevedo
description: Portfolio corporativo premium y administrable para Nathan Quevedo. Next.js 15 + Express + Prisma + MySQL.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start:multi: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build && npm run db:setup
